_doc: Hollowed hounds (ADR-0034): dogs the Bloom took, hunting in packs. Speeds in m/s, ranges in metres. behavior.quadruped sizes the low collision body (a capsule lying along it on the ground: length nose to tail, radius; eye height; unscaled); behavior.pack sets pack size, the howl that rallies it and the hit-and-run of a pack fight (data/config/hounds.json holds the shared tuning).

defs.name: Hollowed Hound
defs.description: A dog the Bloom took: ribs through the mange, shelf fungus down its spine. Hunts in packs by scent, circles, and goes for the back of your legs. Keeps clear of a torch you hold up to it.
